slides.say: How you export a component decides how you must import it. Let us compare the two ways.

slides.text: Default: import it with any name.
slides.say: A default export can be imported with any name you like. Even Banana gives you the same Button.

slides.text: Named: curly braces, same name both sides.
slides.say: A named export uses curly braces, and the name has to match on both sides. That is why it is called named.

slides.text: A file has at most ONE default export, but as many named exports as you like.
slides.say: One rule to remember: a file can have no more than one default export, but as many named exports as you like.

slides.text: One component per file? Default is common. Several? Named.
slides.say: Teams often use a default export when a file has one component, and named exports when it has several. Mix them carefully.
